text.ja: Su–Olson輸送：2023著者公開の独立解析ベンチマーク表 epsilon*I_tau+mu*I_x+I=V+Q; V_tau=E-V; E=.5*integral_-1^1 I dmu; I=2U of Crilly2023Appendix4.1; conserved total epsilon*E+V. Separate periodic companion: epsilon*I_t+mu*I_x=kappa*(V-I), V_t=kappa*(E-V); F approximately -E_x/(3*kappa), (epsilon+1)*E_t approximately E_xx/(3*kappa). For h=2*pi/N, A_N=.1*sin(h/2)/(h/2), E_diff=V_diff=1+A_N*exp[-s/(3*(epsilon+1))]*cos(x), t=kappa*s. 無限領域の対称1次元角度輸送と物質交換で、ε=1、弾性散乱なし、低温の零初期状態です。Q=1を|x|<0.5、0<τ<10に与えます。主計算は左反射・十分遠い右入射真空の半領域で、比較時刻は境界の影響前です。別の同条件比較用の周期セル平均制御は、物理座標x∈[0,2π)、c=ε=1、κ=4/8/16、N=128/512/2048、Q=0、初期I=V=1+0.1cos(x)、s=0/.0625/.125/.25に対するt=κsを用います。この制御は1997のsource駆動問題とは初期・境界・sourceが異なり、制御内のFV・連続角度参照・拡散比較に同じ入力を用います。
text.en: Su–Olson transport: primary2023author-provided analytical benchmark data epsilon*I_tau+mu*I_x+I=V+Q; V_tau=E-V; E=.5*integral_-1^1 I dmu; I=2U of Crilly2023Appendix4.1; conserved total epsilon*E+V. Separate periodic companion: epsilon*I_t+mu*I_x=kappa*(V-I), V_t=kappa*(E-V); F approximately -E_x/(3*kappa), (epsilon+1)*E_t approximately E_xx/(3*kappa). For h=2*pi/N, A_N=.1*sin(h/2)/(h/2), E_diff=V_diff=1+A_N*exp[-s/(3*(epsilon+1))]*cos(x), t=kappa*s. Infinite symmetric1D angular transport/material exchange,epsilon1,no elastic scattering,cold initial state. Source Q1 for |x|<.5 and0<tau<10. Primary half-domain uses reflecting left and distant incoming-vacuum right; comparison times precede boundary influence. A separate matched periodic cell-mean companion uses physical x in [0,2*pi), c=epsilon=1, kappa4/8/16, N128/512/2048, Q0, initial I=V=1+.1cos(x), and t=kappa*s for s=0,.0625,.125,.25. Its IC/BC/source differ from the source-driven1997 benchmark; the FV, continuum-angular and diffusion comparisons within this companion use matched inputs.
